'''Fever wasps''' were insects native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] and the cause of the deadly disease [[Wasp Fever]]. When a victim was stung by a fever wasp, larvae implanted in the victim grew and began to feed on the host's brain cells. The host experienced dementia, then severe seizures and spasms, as if suffering from a head injury. In general, wasp fever only lasted three or four days, which was the incubation period of the larvae. Any [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] stung by the fever wasp was generally considered dead on the spot, and their body was burned to prevent the larvae from hatching and causing more damage.
